name: foray-corpus-export
description: Foray side of the corpus supply (G-10/G-11, docs/roadmap/corpus.md): exports Joey's foraycorpus PostgreSQL catalogue into versioned artifacts and mirrors the foray-transcriptions R2 bucket into data-local/transcripts/. Dependencies are scoped to this directory (same pattern as tools/corpus) so the repo root stays dependency-free. Credentials come from the environment or R2_CREDENTIALS_FILE, never from the tree.
//test: tools/ci/run-suites.mjs discovers this package (it has a package.json with a test script) and invokes it as `npm test -- <files>`, which is why no file pattern is baked in: with arguments it runs exactly the suites CI discovered, and with none it falls back to node --test's own recursive discovery from this directory. The script MUST keep forwarding its arguments (end in `node --test`): one that ignored them would be planned, floored and reported as executed while the named suite never ran. config.test.mjs asserts this.
